cases.phase: Phase 2 single-arm IGNYTE; resubmitted BLA after prior CRL
cases.support: FDA advisory panel voted 10–3 that efficacy was evaluable and clinically meaningful; class 1 resubmission accepted.
cases.counter: Prior CRL and single-arm attribution/durability concerns; advisory vote is not binding.

cases.support: Two 9–0 FDA advisory votes favor benefit-risk in adults 50–64 and 65+; evidence of vaccine efficacy/immunogenicity.
cases.counter: Initial February refusal-to-file and comparator/surrogate questions for ≥65.

cases.therapy: Florquinitau F18 (MK-6240; Tauklarify) tau PET imaging
cases.phase: Two pivotal diagnostic sensitivity/specificity studies, not therapeutic efficacy
cases.support: Both co-primary diagnostic performance endpoints reportedly met; accepted NDA and Fast Track.
cases.counter: Original diagnostic-reader validation, commercial radiochemistry quality and scale-out not independently inspected.

cases.phase: Phase 3 EXCALIBER-RRMM, MRD planned analysis, PFS still ongoing
cases.support: Breakthrough Therapy, Priority Review, supportive MRD-negative remission analysis and established myeloma class.
cases.counter: MRD surrogate, pending PFS maturity, safety and accelerated-approval reliance.

cases.therapy: DTX401 AAV8 gene therapy for GSDIa
cases.support: Week 48 cornstarch use reduced 41% vs 10% placebo (p<0.0001), sustained long-term with maintained glucose control.
cases.counter: AAV vector CMC, liver immune toxicity, durability and very small pivotal patient counts.

cases.support: Pivotal HER2+ GEA trial reported positive benefit; priority sBLA accepted under RTOR, and previously approved later-line antibody.
cases.counter: Need verify regimen-by-regimen survival hierarchy, competing arms, PD-L1 subgroups and toxicity.

cases.therapy: Daraxonrasib for previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer
cases.support: Sponsor reported all primary and key secondary OS/PFS endpoints met against chemotherapy; breakthrough designation and priority voucher.
cases.counter: Very rapid regulatory review; dated August goal not verified, no original FDA review or locked SAP.

cases.support: Primary Week 52 TIS 46.5 vs 31.2, p=0.0006; nine key secondary endpoints positive in sponsor report.
cases.counter: JAK1/TYK2 immunosuppression, serious infection/thrombosis warnings, CMC and submitted exact goal not verified.

cases.phase: Two randomized Phase 3 ARTISTRY-1 and ARTISTRY-2 switch studies
cases.support: Week 48 viral suppression noninferior to baseline stable ART, acceptable safety and already approved component drug classes.
cases.counter: Drug interactions, HBV coverage on regimen switching, resistance and long-term safety.

cases.support: Noninferior to dulaglutide on MACE3, HR 0.92 (95.3% CI 0.83–1.01); existing marketed drug.
cases.counter: Did not demonstrate direct superiority over active comparator (p=0.09); exact proposed label, filing and August goal absent from pre-Aug roster.

cases.support: Placebo 19 new HO lesions vs 1–2 with garetosmab over 56 weeks, p about 0.027 for each dose; severe ultra-rare disease.
cases.counter: Small n=63, dose-specific flare-up heterogeneity, long-term anti-activin-A safety and CMC.
